study type: Institution-based cross sectional study with retrospective chart review
exposure: Rupture of membrane > 12 hours vs. <= 12 hours
Duration of labor > 24 hours vs. <= 24 hours
cohort: 622 women who underwent cesarean section at 3 randomly selected primary hospitals of east Gojjam zone, Northwest Ethiopia
finding: Rural residence, duration of labor greater than 24hrs, rupture of membrane >12hrs, hypertension, and preoperative Hematocrit ≤30% were significantly associated with post-cesarean section surgical site infections.
